title: Action Network public API — historical odds + public bet percentages, keyless

discovery.auth: NONE — plain GET with browser User-Agent
discovery.payload: games[] with teams, start_time, rotation numbers, odds[] per book (up to 33-41 books), each with:
fields: spread_away_public/spread_home_public (PERCENT OF BETS on each side)

coverage_measured.public_bet_pct_by_season: full 2020-2025 (every game, every week), partial 2019, none pre-2019
coverage_measured.odds_records: 2023 W1: 41 book records per game; all 16 games have spread+total
coverage_measured.live: current board with 33 book records per game

why_it_matters_for_the_gate: public bet % = crowd position — the classic contrarian signal plane, never wired into any GSE construction
closing juice by book = market confidence (partially tested via nflverse vig: +0.0009 gain in atoms)
per-book line DISAGREEMENT (dispersion across 30+ books) = uncertainty measure beyond a single closing line
bet% vs money% divergence (tickets vs dollars) = sharp/public split proxy
next_steps: harvest 2020-2025 all weeks (~6x25 requests, ~150 calls, keyless)
build walk-forward features: public% deviation from 50, book-dispersion of closing spread, money%-vs-bet% gap
test in champion v3 cascade: sigma regime + atom key dims
respect their infrastructure: 0.5-1s delay between calls, cache to disk, single harvest pass

companion_apis.scoresandodds_market_comparison: https://rga51lus77.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prod/market-comparison?sport=nfl&event=nfl/{id}&market={spread|total|moneyline} — works, needs live event ids from game pages (data-event="nfl/{id}"), current-day only
